question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**sense**" refers to a faculty by which the body perceives an external stimulus or an intuitive feeling or understanding. (भावना)

 
 
• Example: Traveling alone helped him to gain a deeper **sense** of self.
 
 
 
• **Sense** in this context implies an understanding or realization, particularly of oneself. (भावना)
 
 
• Example: Through travel, she discovered a new **sense** of identity and purpose.
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

**Complete Sentence:** We all travel for different reasons: wanderlust, a want to experience a different culture, a desire to forget, or a desire to meet new people. Traveling becomes a means for people to deal with different situations, try new things, and find their **sense**__ of self.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Scene (दृश्य)**: The place where an incident in real life or fiction occurs or occurred. 

 
 
• Example: The scene of the crime was cordoned off by the police.
 
 
 
• **Mean (माध्यम)**: To intend to convey, indicate, or refer to something. 
 
 
• Example: I didn't mean to hurt your feelings.
 
 
 
• **Place (स्थान)**: A particular position or point in space. 
 
 
• Example: This is a suitable place for a picnic.
